subject: english
stem:
Nora first learned two easy songs. She practiced a hard part slowly and recorded herself each week. After a month, she could hear clear progress.
Which choice gives the central idea?
options: Nora stopped when the music was hard
Regular, focused practice helped Nora improve
Everyone becomes a musician in one month

optionRationales.reason: Nora stopped when the music was hard：她反而慢慢練困難部分。
Regular, focused practice helped Nora improve：學簡曲、慢練難段與錄音追蹤都構成有方法的持續練習。
Nora recorded one song：錄音是每週且只是方法之一。
Everyone becomes a musician in one month：原文只描述 Nora 的進步。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「多句以重複、同義或因果方式回到的共同概念」可推出 Regular, focused practice helped Nora improve；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Regular, focused practice helped Nora improve 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
